items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Salt and black pepper' to USDA SR Legacy 'Spices, pepper, black'. Black pepper is the distinctive food identity in this two-seasoning label; the reviewed corpus already binds both 'Black pepper' and 'Ground black pepper' to FDC 170931, and this target's own pinned evidence contains that exact black-pepper record at rank 2. Confidence remains medium because the USDA row does not include the unspecified added-salt quantity, so sodium can be underrepresented.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Salt and black pepper (to taste)' to USDA SR Legacy 'Spices, pepper, black'. 'To taste' changes quantity rather than ingredient identity; prior reviewed targets bind black pepper to FDC 170931, and this target's own pinned evidence contains that exact record at rank 4. Confidence remains medium because the salt component and its variable sodium contribution are not represented by the pepper-only USDA row.
